comments.text: Bite by night isn't killer sided nor survivor sided they equally both are balanced under the right conditions.. If the survivors are good and they are able to hold their own against the killer when needed and whenever needed support the survivors are able to coordinate then they are going to win however if the killer is good and knows what they are doing they will win. And if they know how to shut down looping spots and counter teamwork then the killer will win there is no survivor side or killer side is better than the other. The game truly is how both sides work, and if the team is smart or not or if the killer is smart or not. So in my opinion both are equally fair and balanced in their own way.

comments.text:
If noclipping is why you think the game is killer sided, then this makes zero sense. Survivors can do the same.

The killer is considered strong because most people who play suck at the game. Instead of focusing on generators or teamwork, most players will go alone, charge at the killer, or hide for no reason.

I know not everyone is like that. However, that is the majority of people who say the game is killer sided. I say this based on evidence and experience.

Now, on small maps, killers might have an advantage, but that's about it. Survivors can literally skip to 4am. Sometimes 5am. If it is a good team.
